8.6.3.29 IUMPRDenominatorCondition
[SWS_Dem_00742] Definition of ClientServerInterface IUMPRDenominatorCondition ⌈ Name IUMPRDenominatorCondition Comment If OBD is configured it broadcasts the status information of the General Denominator and additional denominator conditions among all OBD relevant ECUs. One port of this interface type is provided per denominator condition Id by the Dem Service Component. It has Dem_ IumprDenomCondId as a port-defined argument. IsService true Variation
–
0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors
